findings.evidence: src/repo_hygiene/eval_adapter.py:641-656 (`JS_COMMENT_RE = ^[ \t]*//.*$`, `HTML_COMMENT_RE`, no `/* */`); the docstring at :758-762 claims 'each of which must appear exactly once in the file's LIVE text - commented-out code stripped, so a dead call site cannot satisfy its own pin', and pair B triage shape 3 commits only the `//` spelling. Trigger 1 (R6 class): block-comment the url call site's live line in index.html and follow it with a body that omits the flag - the URL mode stops sending it, ticking the checkbox does nothing for that mode. Trigger 2 (R5 class): block-comment the pinned truncation expression and follow it with `${it.text.length.toLocaleString()}` - the truncation notice counts the UN-stripped string under a 'boilerplate hidden' header, exactly R5.

findings.acceptance: ROUTE_RE matches `@app.post("/api/extract/..."` regardless of what follows the literal (drop the trailing `\)`), and pair B's paste route carries a decorator kwarg so the kwarg spelling is the one watched red.
